result.quote: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. The attack was so violent that they ran out of the house naked and wounded.
result.reason: Verse 19:16 supports the keyed outcome, but the clean window never identifies “them” as the seven sons of Sceva or even states that there were seven. The edited subject therefore relies on missing context. The wording itself is natural and clear. The source pair identifies the people only as seven Jewish exorcists, so it does not independently verify the edit’s new identification as Sceva’s sons.
